evidence/body.text: I wonder if we could build a way for me to inject things into sessionista mood's list directly? E.g. if I write [[Inbox Zero]] or [[Warrant]] then we'd know that I am "introducing these as named entities in this turn".  Now of course these terms have been used for ages, but this is where XTDB could be helpful, i.e., a term really can't be introduced until it has some referents, though it doesn't need to have preexisting usage; e.g. [[sessionista-mode]] would be totally novel usage when it was introduced but it referred to "by analogy with session mode" and "fast like 小象"
